capability: Label each note by kind; fit it where it belongs
title: Give every note a label.

hook.picture: Close on the whale dropping two near-identical grey cards, an old draft and the final decision, into one huge pasted card on the line.

problem_in_viewer_words.body: It quoted our old draft like it was the decision.
problem_in_viewer_words.who: project lead reading the AI summary on Monday

why_it_keeps_happening.picture: Pull back: sixteen grey cards on the line, drafts and decisions side by side. Look-alike pairs drop in every 2 beats, then 1, then half; each time the pod grabs the draft.
why_it_keeps_happening.words: Each note shows up looking the same.

stakes.body: A decision gets reversed in front of the client, and the team stops trusting the summary.

solution_hint: Label each note by what it is.

metaphor.body: Notes are cards that all look the same until each gets a coloured tab for its kind; the brief is a tree of sockets that only takes the right kind in each slot.

steps.picture: The cards freeze and tabs colour in: yellow for draft, deep green for decided, pink for rule; one of each lifts out, named inside.
steps.sound: Three tuned wooden clicks, one per colour

steps.picture: A tree of sockets hangs over the line from a brief; each socket notch shows the tab colour it accepts.
steps.words: Label it: draft, decided, or rule.

steps.picture: The green decided card glides up into the middle socket and snaps; a tick appears at its joint.
Push-in: the whale nudges the yellow draft at the second decided socket; it is refused at the joint, rust cross, small shake, and drops back to the line.
steps.words: A draft cannot fill a decision slot.
steps.sound: The click, muffled and a half-step flat

steps.picture: The pink rule card snaps into its own socket, a real decision fills the second slot, and receipts tick up the branches to the brief.
steps.sound: Clean clicks, then soft ticks climbing to a bell

steps.picture: The tree settles; every card shows its tab.
steps.words: Labelled cards that fit slots: atoms.

real_case.claim: Context Atoms first three jobs (16 Oct 2026): 3 prompts; 41, 26 and 41 atoms; engine verdict GREEN; 9 atoms shared by all three (the spine), still Draft, to be verified first.

honest_limit.picture: A green decided card snaps into a decided socket and gets its receipt, but its words carry a rust smudge: someone marked a wrong date as decided.
honest_limit.words: A wrong date marked decided still fits.

not_this.body: Labels catch mix-ups, not wrong facts.

ending_pattern.body: The same two look-alike cards return in the FELT framing, now tabbed yellow and green. The decided card snaps into a small brief; the draft bounces off and floats aside; the pod answers with a tick.
ending_pattern.callback: In bar 2 the pod quoted the draft from a huge pasted card; now, same framing, the brief is small and the draft cannot get in.

end_belief.body: Say what each piece is before you send.

The whale leans toward the two crosses (focus face). Hold.

All motion stops; faint tab colours ghost onto every card.

beats.picture: Wide: three blocks of small tabbed cards hang from three roots, one per real prompt (41, 26 and 41 cards); the Real run card fades in.
beats.sound: Pulse bed starts, quiet receipt ticks

beats.picture: The block rows tick on the beat; a dashed line joins the first row of all three blocks: the shared nine.
beats.words: Three real prompts, built this way.
beats.sound: Pulse bed, a three-note figure on the shared row

beats.picture: The dashed outlines around the shared rows pulse once and stay dashed: still draft, queued for a person.
beats.words: The shared ones get a human check next.

beats.picture: The whale pushes a green decided card whose words carry a rust smudge (a wrong date) into a decided socket; it snaps and gets its receipt.

beats.picture: Close on the smudged card holding its socket; the tick beside it does not change.

beats.picture: FELT framing restored: in place of the huge card, a small brief with a decided socket. The decided card snaps in and ticks; the yellow draft bounces off the brief and floats aside.

beats.picture: The pod returns; only the decided socket glows for it; its answer circles a line in green with a thread to the decided card, and its chip shows a tick. The whale sparks.
The pod leaves with its tick; the draft floats harmlessly beside the whale.
The settled image; the whale breathes and spouts once.

score_self.reason: Problem, move and payoff read without sound; the FELT/PAYOFF callback is exact. Risks: dark-green decided tabs read close to black; the case blocks are small; the spine idea needs the card to land.
